name: detail-D-wall_foundation-BASEMENT_10-EXT_2X6
notes: • Framed wall: 2x6 at 16" o.c., R-19 bays, 4" continuous exterior.
• Pour and steel per the S-100 schedule.
• 60 mil waterproofing, footing to grade (Minn. R. 1309.0406).
• CI: 4" XPS, two layers, seams staggered, outer taped; grade-6" up: 1/8" acrylic on mesh, 276.3 SF.
• Seat: pour top -13 7/16"; one shared 2x6 PT mudsill (329.3 LF) on 1/16" EPDM, 11 7/8" rim.
• Slab: 3-1/2" at 4,000 psi on 2" XPS, 10 mil poly, 4" stone. Drain: 4" pipe.
• 2"x2" perforated aluminium U on the Z; base trim 1" up, lapping it on EPDM.
• L-flashing from sheathing base onto the foam; seal its outer end.
• Slab perimeter: 1" XPS thermal break with 1/2" polyurethane sealant.
K1  Bituthene 3000 or equal, concrete to sheathing; 2" laps, 2-ply corners; backfill in 30 days.
K2  Z-flashing with drip at the girt band base, set to the 2" cavity.
K5  Mudsill anchors per IRC R403.1.6. Plate joint peel-and-stick on the envelope.
